items.title: LLM always returns 17 when I ask it 'Give me a number between 1 and 30'
items.body:
I am using Chatgpt and Gemini, whenever I ask it the question 'Give me a number between 1 and 30' it always responds with 17. I thought LLM were non-deterministic. Is there a core reason this number is chosen every time?

By whenever I mean 15 different times across 3 devices. All of them returned 17. I have not done a larger test.

items.title: AGI running on a analog computer?
items.body: Digital computers dont seem to be able to produce sentience, what about analog computers?Have we tried working with analog computers and training AI within them?
